newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields edge up amid budget scepticism.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields edge up amid budget scepticism.

text.p: Swedish debt yields rose in Wednesday morning trade despite stronger foreign markets and the crown weakened to the mark.
Dealers attributed the weakness to concerns over the Swedish supplementary budget that was presented on Tuesday.

"I think there is some scepticism about the budget," said one dealer. "The big question is how the five point spending programme will be handled if we don't get the forecasted budget surpluses in coming years."
Six month T-bill rates rose two basis points to 4.11 pct.
The ten year bond yield edged up two to 7.14 percent.
Dealers said the market was also looking at U.S. statistics on housing starts, industrial production and capacity utilisation due out later on Wednesday.
The crown softened to 4.4640 crowns to the mark versus 4.4415 late on Tuesday.
